subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these verified action-release revisions in the secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, repository-mutation, and Codex-agent workflows on the final rebased SHA?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness finding, but the protected security label and privileged execution surfaces require an owner to accept the residual third-party-code and operational risk.

options.title: Refresh, verify, and approve
options.body: Rebase to current main, require exact-head checks, and approve the verified grouped revisions after reviewing the privileged workflows.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token creation, registry publishing, CodeQL upload, Codex execution, and repository mutation pins into smaller reviews before approval.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Keep the PR open until Dependabot access and exact-head stability are restored, or close it in favor of fresh narrower bumps.

recommendation.title: Refresh, verify, and approve
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, require exact-head checks, and approve the verified grouped revisions after reviewing the privileged workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows broad recent ownership across CI, Docker, and Codex-agent workflows, and the timeline records direct involvement on this PR.
